message.content: {"6632_8353801543185": {"answer": "C", "reason": "Comparing Figure 1 (2003) and Figure 2 (2007), there is a marked increase in opacity and pleural-based thickening in the left upper zone, which in the context of chronic sarcoidosis raises suspicion for an aspergilloma (mycetoma) forming within a pre-existing cavity."}, "6632_8353801552900": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The 2007 radiograph demonstrates increased density and pleural thickening in the left upper zone compared to 2003; this progression in a patient with fibrotic sarcoidosis is highly suggestive of a superimposed aspergillus mycetoma."}, "6632_8353801559626": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The left upper zone shows progressive opacification and apparent pleural thickening between the two timepoints, a finding that clinically warrants investigation for a mycetoma colonizing a sarcoid cavity."}}
